evidence.quote: Perhaps the best known of the divergent boundaries is the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.

claims.statement: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is described as one of the best-known divergent boundaries.

evidence.quote: This submerged mountain range, which extends from the Arctic Ocean to beyond the southern tip of Africa, is but one segment of the global mid-ocean ridge system that encircles the Earth.

claims.statement: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is one segment of the global mid-ocean ridge system.

evidence.quote: Divergent boundaries occur along spreading centers where plates are moving apart and new crust is created by magma pushing up from the mantle.

claims.statement: Magma pushing up from the mantle creates new crust at spreading centers.

evidence.quote: This rate may seem slow by human standards, but because this process has been going on for millions of years, it has resulted in plate movement of thousands of kilometers.

claims.statement: Seafloor spreading over millions of years has resulted in plate movement of thousands of kilometers.

evidence.quote: Seafloor spreading over the past 100 to 200 million years has caused the Atlantic Ocean to grow from a tiny inlet of water between the continents of Europe, Africa, and the Americas into the vast ocean that exists today.

claims.statement: Seafloor spreading caused the Atlantic Ocean to grow from a small inlet into its present vast ocean.

evidence.quote: Here, existing ground cracks have widened and new ones appear every few months.

claims.statement: The consequences of plate movement include widening existing ground cracks and the appearance of new ones around Krafla Volcano.

evidence.quote: Between 1975 and 1984, the displacements caused by rifting totalled about 7 m.

claims.statement: The displacements at Krafla were caused by rifting.

evidence.quote: the ground would gradually rise 1-2 m before abruptly dropping, signalling an impending eruption.

claims.statement: Ground rise and abrupt dropping signalled an impending eruption.

evidence.quote: In East Africa, spreading processes have already torn Saudi Arabia away from the rest of the African continent, forming the Red Sea.

claims.statement: Spreading processes tore Saudi Arabia away from the rest of Africa, forming the Red Sea.

evidence.quote: When the continental crust stretches beyond its limits, tension cracks begin to appear on the Earth's surface.

claims.statement: When continental crust stretches beyond its limits, tension cracks appear on Earth's surface.

evidence.quote: The rising magma, whether or not it erupts, puts more pressure on the crust to produce additional fractures and, ultimately, the rift zone.

claims.statement: Rising magma puts more pressure on the crust.

claims.statement: Magma pressure produces additional fractures in the crust.

claims.statement: Crustal fractures contribute ultimately to the formation of a rift zone.

evidence.quote: The rate of spreading along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge averages about 2.5 centimeters per year (cm/yr), or 25 km in a million years.

claims.statement: The spreading rate along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge averages about 2.5 centimeters per year, or 25 kilometers in a million years.

evidence.quote: The volcanic country of Iceland, which straddles the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, offers scientists a natural laboratory for studying on land the processes also occurring along the submerged parts of a spreading ridge.

claims.statement: Iceland straddles the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and provides a natural laboratory for studying spreading processes on land.

evidence.quote: Iceland is splitting along the spreading center between the North American and Eurasian Plates, as North America moves westward relative to Eurasia.

claims.statement: Iceland is splitting along the spreading center between the North American and Eurasian Plates.

evidence.quote: From 1975 to 1984, numerous episodes of rifting (surface cracking) took place along the Krafla fissure zone.

claims.statement: Numerous episodes of rifting took place along the Krafla fissure zone from 1975 to 1984.

evidence.quote: Some of these rifting events were accompanied by volcanic activity;

claims.statement: Some rifting events were accompanied by volcanic activity.

evidence.quote: The actively splitting African Plate and the Arabian Plate meet in what geologists call a triple junction, where the Red Sea meets the Gulf of Aden.

claims.statement: The actively splitting African Plate and Arabian Plate meet at a triple junction where the Red Sea meets the Gulf of Aden.

evidence.quote: A new spreading center may be developing under Africa along the East African Rift Zone.

claims.statement: A new spreading center may be developing under Africa along the East African Rift Zone.

evidence.quote: Magma rises and squeezes through the widening cracks, sometimes to erupt and form volcanoes.

claims.statement: Magma can squeeze through widening cracks and sometimes erupt to form volcanoes.

evidence.quote: Picture two giant conveyor belts, facing each other but slowly moving in opposite directions as they transport newly formed oceanic crust away from the ridge crest.

claims.statement: Newly formed oceanic crust is transported away from the ridge crest as plates move in opposite directions.
